snippet.title: RKR - Rush Kill Repeat - UX/UI Update Trailer
snippet.description:
The next RKR Update is right around the corner! On October 10th, expect the look and feel of 'RKR - Rush Kill Repeat' to change completely with the new 'UX/UI Update'. Along with many quality-of-life fixes, RKR's UX/UI Update updates visuals for almost every screen in the game, including the menu, rearranging the GUI during gameplay, camera fixes, and more!

In addition to the UI polish, guns have changed completely. Rather than switching guns randomly after every kill, you can now encounter gun crates, in which you may discover better (or worse) guns. You finally have full control over which gun you choose to continue your run with.

Finally, a new coloured variant of the classic environment has been implemented to shake things up a bit for the player.

Check out RKR - Rush Kill Repeat on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137680/RKR__Rush_Kill_Repeat/

Join our Community: https://discord.gg/2zch5Dv

Soundtrack by @biuuuwulf6975 : https://open.spotify.com/artist/20TXOIdavhSODEShafChxX
